title: The first scout falls
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: darkening storm at dusk, cold slate-blue light, rain, lightning on the horizon.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; small gunmetal-grey scout drones the size of seagulls, each with a single crimson optical visor and whirring rotors.
Camera: wide shot tracking a redirected drone; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: The hero yanks a grapple cable and swings the tangled scout drone off course into a hanging fishing net strung beneath the catwalk, where it bounces harmlessly and gets stuck.
No dialogue.
Sound: cable tension, whoosh, net thwump, rotor sputter.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (the masked hero, scout drones), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: The netted drone's rotors sputter and stop.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: cable tension, whoosh, net thwump, rotor sputter.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
negative_prompt: text, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicated characters, sudden wardrobe changes, costume swaps, graphic injury, blood, gore, still image, slideshow, freeze frame, live action humans, 2D flat animation, anime, background music
